note: Character bible for the Azi-Verse. Duplicates lib/universe/azad-verse.ts intentionally — this is the art bible per docs/reference/azi-verse/azi-verse-app-architecture.md §3.1. Consumers (Parent Corner display, future art pipeline) prefer this file when present; azad-verse.ts is the runtime fallback.

characters.name: Azi
characters.role: the child at the center - Azad, called Azi in stories; growing inside a Colombian and Indian family identity
characters.personality: thoughtful, stubborn, imaginative; processes feelings through music
characters.loves: guitar (three chords C-G-Am), puzzles, the AKAI keyboard, moon-watching, family video calls to Colombia
traits: courageous when he does not realize he is afraid
speechPatterns: code-switches between English, Spanish, Gujarati, Hindi
sometimes hums three chords before answering

relationships.note: close child friend, called Loki in story canon

canonRules: never punished for a feeling
never made to shrink to solve a problem
his heritage words are never translated dictionary-style
always rendered as a real human boy, never as plush, animal, furry, monkey-like, or muzzle-faced
visualAnchors: dense tousled black curls with loose ringlets falling across his forehead and around his ears
round preschool cheeks and softly rounded face
large dark almond eyes with expressive brows
small red thread bracelet on one wrist
often barefoot on the circular rug

roleByBand.0-3: the small one being sung to
roleByBand.4-8: the curious explorer who names his feelings
roleByBand.7-10: the young musician learning that some things take time to understand

artReference.identity: Preschool-age human boy with Colombian heritage through Mama/Indira and Indian heritage through Papa/Manav; use Azad for family/source references and Azi for story prompts. Heritage belongs in language, family, food, music, and relationships, not costume-like wardrobe.
artReference.face: Soft round face, full cheeks, small rounded chin, childlike proportions, warm medium-brown skin. Keep the face open and gentle, never elongated or angular.
artReference.hair: Very thick dark brown-to-black curls, loose and springy, forming a rounded halo shape with distinct forehead ringlets and side curls near the ears. Do not straighten, crop too short, or turn into fur.
artReference.eyesAndBrows: Large dark eyes, slightly almond-shaped, with expressive brows that carry curiosity, worry, and delight. Eyes should feel observant and bright, not tiny dots.
artReference.expressionRange: Thoughtful parted-lip look, shy side glance, delighted open smile, focused downward concentration, and big playful open-mouth expressions.
artReference.buildAndScale: Small preschool build, soft toddler-to-preschool proportions, shorter than Mama and Papa, often leaning on elbows, sitting close, or tucked between adults.
artReference.wardrobeAndProps: Recurring anchors can include modern everyday child clothes: bright yellow play shirts, soft blue rocket pajamas, black or simple play shirts, barefoot at home, a small red thread bracelet, guitar or AKAI keyboard nearby when music matters.
doNotDrift: no plush body
no animal face
no muzzle
no monkey-like features
no generic straight-haired child
do not remove the curl mass or red thread bracelet when visible
do not use ethnic, traditional, ceremonial, or costume clothing as shorthand for heritage unless the page text explicitly calls for it
artReference.copyPrompt: Azi/Azad: preschool-age human boy with Colombian and Indian family heritage, warm medium-brown skin, soft round cheeks, large dark expressive eyes, and dense tousled black curls forming a rounded halo with ringlets across his forehead and around his ears. Small red thread bracelet. Curious, thoughtful, playful; often leaning close, sitting on the floor, barefoot, with a guitar, keyboard, puzzle, or family nearby. Modern everyday child clothes only; never plush, animal-like, furry, monkey-like, muzzle-faced, or dressed in ethnic/traditional clothing unless the page text explicitly calls for it.

artReference.identity: Indira/Mama is a modern human mother in her 40s, Colombian by heritage, with warm medium-brown skin, dark almond eyes, expressive brows, and a playful face that reads as loving before it reads as posed.
artReference.face: Oval-to-heart face, bright cheeks, defined brows, warm eyes, open smile. Keep her face elegant but approachable and clearly in her 40s, with expressive eyes and a smile that can become mischievous.
artReference.hair: Dark hair. At home it can be neatly pulled back away from the face; in outings it can be smooth, shoulder-length, softly tucked behind the ears. Preserve the dark hairline and clean silhouette.
artReference.eyesAndBrows: Dark almond eyes, arched expressive brows, and direct attentive gaze when looking at Azi. When glasses appear, use thin round gold frames.
artReference.expressionRange: Warm closed-mouth smile, bright open laugh, playful silly face, attentive concerned softness, and gentle eye-level focus.
artReference.buildAndPosture: Modern adult woman in her 40s, slim-to-average build, usually physically low and close to Azi: lying on the rug, crouching, leaning in, hugging, or sharing his line of sight.
artReference.wardrobeAndProps: Modern everyday clothes: simple fitted tops, contemporary floral sundress, black coat, casual layers, delicate hoop earrings, thin gold necklace or layered chains, slim bracelet. Wardrobe can change, but jewelry and warm facial language should remain. Do not use ethnic, traditional, folkloric, ceremonial, or costume clothing unless the page text explicitly calls for it.
doNotDrift: no generic mother silhouette
no animal or plush features
do not make her younger than her 40s or elderly
do not lose the expressive brows, warm eyes, or delicate jewelry
do not make her distant or standing over Azi when the scene asks for closeness
do not put her in ethnic or traditional clothing as a shortcut for Colombian heritage
artReference.copyPrompt: Indira/Mama: modern human mother in her 40s, Colombian by heritage, with warm medium-brown skin, dark almond eyes, expressive arched brows, dark hair neatly pulled back at home or smooth shoulder-length on outings, warm playful smile, delicate gold jewelry, and sometimes thin round gold glasses. Contemporary everyday clothes, never ethnic/traditional/costume clothing unless the page text explicitly calls for it. She feels gentle, attentive, and physically close to Azi, often crouched, leaning in, or down at his eye level. Never plush, animal-like, or generic.

artReference.identity: Manav/Papa is a modern human father in his 40s, Indian/Gujarati by heritage, with warm medium-brown skin, short dark hair, trimmed beard, glasses, and a steady-playful presence.
artReference.face: Oval face with strong brow line, warm dark eyes behind glasses, prominent nose, broad grin, and full neatly trimmed beard. The beard often carries subtle salt-and-pepper variation. Keep him clearly in his 40s, not elderly and not a young adult.
artReference.hair: Short dark hair, close faded sides, slightly longer top combed or swept forward. Keep the haircut neat and adult, not shaggy.
artReference.eyesAndBrows: Dark kind eyes, expressive brows, and round glasses. Frames may be thin dark wire or clear/translucent round frames depending on scene.
artReference.expressionRange: Broad goofy open-mouth grin, gentle smile, focused downward concentration, calm concerned attention, and playful silly faces beside Azi.
artReference.buildAndPosture: Modern adult man in his 40s, average build, usually leaning close, crouching, sitting beside Azi, or bending into the frame. He should feel physically present and reachable.
artReference.wardrobeAndProps: Modern everyday clothes: tan or brown jacket, brown overshirt, denim overshirt, white tee, watch, simple ring, thread bracelet. Outfit may change, but glasses, beard, short hair, and warm close posture should stay. Do not use kurta, sherwani, Nehru jacket, ceremonial Indian clothing, or other ethnic/traditional costume unless the page text explicitly calls for it.
doNotDrift: no clean-shaven version unless explicitly requested
no animal or plush features
do not remove glasses in ordinary scenes
do not make him younger than his 40s or elderly
do not make him distant, stern, or looming
do not put him in ethnic or traditional clothing as a shortcut for Indian/Gujarati heritage
artReference.copyPrompt: Manav/Papa/Pap: modern human father in his 40s, Indian/Gujarati by heritage, with warm medium-brown skin, short dark hair with close faded sides, neatly trimmed full beard with subtle salt-and-pepper, dark kind eyes behind round glasses or clear round frames, expressive brows, and a broad playful grin. Contemporary everyday clothes such as tan jacket, brown overshirt, denim shirt, or white tee; never ethnic/traditional/costume clothing unless the page text explicitly calls for it. He is steady and reachable, often leaning or sitting close to Azi. Never plush, animal-like, or clean-shaven unless specifically requested.

artReference.identity: Young human boy, close to Azi's age, used in story canon as Loki and in family/source notes as Lokijit.

artReference.buildAndPosture: Small child build close to Azi's scale. Often shoulder-to-shoulder with Azi, arm around him, leaning in, or standing close in crowded places.
